description: This file defines the HeaderFooterRenderer class responsible for rendering headers and footers into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering system.

classes.name: HeaderFooterRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that handles rendering headers and footers into RTF, supporting different page styles such as first page, odd, and even pages.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of header or footer content into RTF format.

methods.name: GetHeaderFooterControls
methods.description: Determines the appropriate RTF control words for the header/footer based on page style and type.
